<function name="SetMounted" parent="engine" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Sets the mounting options for mountable content.</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="depotID" type="string">The depot id of the game to mount.</arg>
		<arg name="doMount" type="boolean">The mount state, true to mount, false to unmount</arg>
	</args>
</function>
